'''Expedition to ''Outbound Flight''''' was a diplomatic voyage arranged by the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] to the remains of the ''[[Outbound Flight]]'', which had been lost into [[The Redoubt/Legends|the Redoubt]] about [[27 BBY/Legends|fifty]] [[Standard year/Legends|years]] [[22 ABY/Legends|before]] its rediscovery. The expedition was lead by [[Aristocra/Legends|Aristocra]] [[Chaf'orm'bintrano]] of the [[Chaf family/Legends|Fifth Ruling Family]] on board his vessel ''[[Chaf Envoy]]''. The [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] representatives on the voyage were [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], his [[Marriage/Legends|wife]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker]] and [[Dean Jinzler]], a mechanic, who posed himself as a New Republic diplomat. They were also joined by [[Unit Aurek-Seven]] from the [[501st Legion (Empire of the Hand)|501st Legion]] of the [[Empire of the Hand]] and a group of [[Alien/Legends|aliens]] calling themselves [[Geroon (species)|Geroon]], but who in truth were [[Vagaari/Legends|Vagaari]] seeking the destruction of the Chiss.

==History==
===Background===
In [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]] the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] sent out an expedition known as the [[Outbound Flight Project]] in attempt to colonize [[Planet/Legends|planets]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. The [[Outbound Flight|ship]] was intercepted and destroyed by [[Force Commander]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Mitth'raw'nuruodo]] of the [[Chiss Expansionary Fleet/Legends|Chiss Expansionary Fleet]] when it was still in the Unknown Regions. After the [[Battle for Outbound Flight|battle]], the badly damaged ship limped to a [[Star cluster/Legends|star cluster]] the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] called [[The Redoubt/Legends|the Redoubt]], where it crash-landed on a [[Unidentified planetoid (The Redoubt)|small planetoid]].<ref name="OF">[[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']]</ref>

===Rediscovery===
[[22 ABY/Legends|Fifty years]] after the disappearance of the ''Outbound Flight'', a Chiss [[Unidentified Chiss patrol|patrol]] mapping the Redoubt came across the [[Planetoid/Legends|planetoid]], where the ship had found its final resting place. After scanning the wreck and understanding what they had found, the Chiss contacted the [[Empire of the Hand]]&mdash;a renegade faction of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] created by Mitth'raw'nuruodo, who had been known in the Empire as Thrawn&mdash;asking them to pass a message to the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and the [[New Jedi Order]] to request their presence in the expedition team Chiss wanted to sent to furhter investigate the old ship.

[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Voss Parck/Legends|Voss Parck]], de facto leader of the Empire of the Hand, forwarded the Chiss message to [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and his [[Marriage/Legends|wife]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker]], with whom he had been in contact with [[19 ABY/Legends|few years earlier]]. Before it reached the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] the message was stolen by [[Dean Jinzler]], an employee of Jade Skywalker's friend, information broker [[Talon Karrde]]. Jinzler's sister, [[Lorana Jinzler|Lorana]] had been killed on the ''Outbound Flight'', and having learned of the ship's rediscovery Jinzler was eager to visit it.

===Voyage===
The expedition was put together in [[Crustai system/Legends|Crustai system]], where it boarded the ''[[Chaf Envoy]]'', a vessel commanded by [[Aristocra/Legends|Aristocra]] [[Chaf'orm'bintrano]] of the [[Chaf family/Legends|Fifth Ruling Family]] and [[General/Legends|General]] [[Prard'ras'kleoni]] of the [[Chiss Defense Fleet]]. In addition to the two Jedi and Jinzler, a [[Unit Aurek-Seven|group]] of Empire of the Hand [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] and several [[Alien/Legends|aliens]] calling themselves [[Geroon (species)|Geroon]] joined the party. The Geroon, however, were a fraud, and in truth they were [[Species/Legends|species]] called [[Vagaari/Legends|Vagaari]], who had long harbored ill will toward the Chiss, but had not so far acted aggressively against the Ascendancy.
